text: Intercepted German signals showed that, even four hours after the landings began, twenty-one aircraft were leaving Sicily to reinforce Sardinia. Weeks later, Hitler was still expecting a blow in the Balkans. In late July, he sent Field Marshal Erwin Rommel to Greece to prepare its defence.
